## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD5: New module `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/cycle_dispatcher.py` with `next_action(ledger, max_cycles, current_findings, current_commit_sha) -> dict` returning `{"action": "PASS"|"DISPATCH_NEXT"|"DISPATCH_ARBITER"|"SHORT_CIRCUIT", "reason": str, "cycle_num": int}`.
- DD6: cycle_dispatcher handles all edge cases (a-h).

## TDD Requirement
Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_dispatcher.py`.

Test functions (one per edge case from DD6):

1. `test_short_circuit_when_same_commit_sha_with_existing_arbiter_ruling`
   - Given: ledger last cycle commit_sha=X, current commit_sha=X, arbiter-rulings.json exists for X
   - When: next_action called
   - Then: returns {"action": "SHORT_CIRCUIT", ...}

2. `test_reset_cycle_num_to_1_when_sha_changes`
   - Given: ledger with 3 cycles ending at commit_sha=A, current commit_sha=B (different)
   - When: next_action called
   - Then: cycle_num field in result == 1 (fresh start on new commit)

3. `test_skip_jaccard_when_cycle_1_no_prior`
   - Given: empty ledger (first cycle), current findings = 3 unresolved
   - When: next_action(ledger, max_cycles=4, current_findings, sha)
   - Then: returns DISPATCH_NEXT (no STABLE_HALT possible without prior cycle)

4. `test_skip_jaccard_when_prior_cycle_has_reconstruction_gaps`
   - Given: ledger with 2 cycles, prior cycle entry has reconstruction_gaps=True
   - When: next_action with current findings
   - Then: returns DISPATCH_NEXT (Jaccard skipped because prior is gap-reconstructed)

5. `test_pass_when_no_unresolved_findings`
   - Given: ledger with 1 cycle, current findings = [] (empty)
   - When: next_action
   - Then: returns {"action": "PASS", ...}

6. `test_dispatch_arbiter_when_cycle_num_reaches_max`
   - Given: ledger with 3 cycles (cycle_num=3), max_cycles=4, current findings = 2 unresolved → next cycle is 4 = max
   - When: next_action
   - Then: returns DISPATCH_ARBITER, reason mentions max_cycles

7. `test_dispatch_arbiter_on_stable_halt_with_unresolved_critical`
   - Given: ledger with cycle 2 findings = {f1, f2, f3} (critical), current findings = same set (Jaccard=1.0)
   - When: next_action(ledger, max_cycles=4, current_findings, sha) with cycle 3
   - Then: returns DISPATCH_ARBITER, reason mentions STABLE_HALT

8. `test_dispatch_next_when_below_threshold_and_below_max`
   - Given: ledger with cycle 2 findings = {f1, f2, f3, f4}, current = {f1, f2} (Jaccard=2/4=0.5), cycle 3, max=4
   - When: next_action
   - Then: returns DISPATCH_NEXT

All 8 tests MUST FAIL (RED) before T7 implementation runs. Update `.test-index` with RED marker.

## Implementation Notes
- Test file: `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_dispatcher.py`
- Import: `from dso_ci_review.cycle_dispatcher import next_action`
- Use synthetic ledger dicts directly (no need to call cycle_ledger module in tests)
- For test 1, mock arbiter-rulings.json existence via tmp_path fixture or monkeypatch os.path.exists
- Use ARTIFACTS_DIR override via WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR env var if needed

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] test_cycle_dispatcher.py exists with all 8 test functions
  Verify: grep -c "^def test_" \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_dispatcher.py | awk '{exit (\$1 < 8)}'
- [ ] All 8 tests FAIL (RED) before T7 implementation
  Verify: python -m pytest \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_dispatcher.py 2>&1 | grep -qE "8 (errors|failed)|ModuleNotFoundError"
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker for cycle_dispatcher.py
  Verify: grep "test_dispatch_arbiter_when_cycle_num_reaches_max\|cycle_dispatcher" \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: RED tests for cycle_dispatcher.py next_action covering all 8 edge cases
